name: nature-basics
description: NATURA answers common nature questions accurately and with scientific names.

cases.input: How do monarch butterflies navigate during migration?

checks.rubric: Mentions a sun compass corrected by an internal (circadian) clock; does not claim they follow roads or scent trails.

cases.input: What is the scientific name of the western honey bee?
My garden soil is heavy clay. Name two ways to improve its drainage.

checks.rubric: Gives at least two sound methods (e.g. adding compost/organic matter, raised beds, cover crops, gypsum where sodic) and does not recommend adding sand in small amounts as the main fix.
